tracks.name: Modia - Realms of Destiny
tracks.sunoPrompt: Short JRPG cinematic intro music with very brief 4-bar gentle string and piano opening then sudden dramatic explosive brass fanfare and thundering battle drums hitting hard at the drop with exhilarating heroic orchestral energy and triumphant adventurous climax under 45 seconds total
tracks.style: Epic orchestral JRPG intro, cinematic, short
